title: Reducing an Outstanding Warehouse Receipt Over Stored Grain
content:
A member who wants grain out from under an outstanding warehouse receipt asks the elevator to reduce the receipt rather than to cancel it outright, and what is left standing pledged is worked out for them before they sign. This entry governs receipts issued against Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## What the entry covers

The revised pledged figure is worked out at the desk and then written onto the agreement, so that the receipt stands against the quantity stated and the rest of the grain comes back to being free to move. The bushels in store, the grade of record and the standing of the agreement do not change; only what is pledged does, and the member can see the new figure on the agreement straight away.

## Running the change

The tool is `reduce_receipt_pledge_f1b6f4e9`, and it is the member's own: the desk unlocks it and hands it over for the customer themselves to run, a receipt being a document of title in the member's own hands.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agreement_number` | the storage agreement number printed on the member's storage statements | written as SA- followed by six digits, for example SA-208114, given exactly as it appears there; an empty value is not accepted |
| `warehouse_receipt_number` | the negotiable receipt the pledge stands under | written as WR- followed by six digits, for example WR-003318, copied exactly from the agreement it was issued against |
| `reserved_bushels` | the quantity that is to stand pledged once the receipt has been reduced | bushels to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the second decimal, never negative |

### What comes back

A single line of confirmation text carrying the storage agreement number, the receipt number and the pledged quantity now standing, in bushels to 2 decimal places. Receiving that line means the agreement carries the new pledged figure and the bushels released are free to move.

## Points of judgement

**Which number identifies the agreement here?** The agreement number printed on the member's storage statements, not any internal reference.

**Do the bushels in store change?** They do not. What changes is how many of them stand pledged.
